   3| Every sale of Corvid Retail reaches the Sales warehouse through the pipeline of this section.

   6| ### 5.1 Sources and stages
   7| 
   8| Three sources deliver sales records. Each source drops its files into the Raw zone bucket.
   9| 
  10| | Source | What it delivers | Delivery |
  11| | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  12| | POS feeds | one CSV file per region and hour, over SFTP | hourly |
  13| | Web orders | a JSON export of the web shop's orders | hourly |
  14| | Loyalty CSV | the purchases of loyalty card holders | daily |
  15| 
  16| The 12 regional POS feeds are North, North-East, East, South-East, South, South-West, West,
  17| North-West, Central, Highlands, Coast and Islands.
  18| 
  19| | Stage | Runs | Reads | Writes |
  20| | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  21| | Normalizer | hourly | Raw zone | Staging tables |
  22| | Deduplicator | hourly, after Normalizer | Staging tables | Clean sales |
  23| | Warehouse loader | nightly | Clean sales | Sales warehouse |
  24| 
  25| ### 5.2 Consumers
  26| 
  27| - Finance dashboards read the Sales warehouse.
  28| - The Demand forecast job runs weekly. It reads the Sales warehouse.
  29| - The Demand forecast job writes forecasts to the Planning system, an external supply system.
  30| - The Data quality monitor reads Staging tables and the Sales warehouse.
  31| - The Data quality monitor alerts `#sales-data-oncall` when a feed is more than 2 h late.
  32| 
  33| ### 5.3 Retention and late files
  34| 
  35| | Store | Keeps data for |
  36| | :--- | :--- |
  37| | Raw zone | 90 days |
  38| | Sales warehouse | 7 years |
  39| 
  40| A late file is accepted for 48 h after its hour. A file that arrives later is rejected.
